page.layout: One page of text, single column. Title block at the top (ornament, title in large capitals over four lines), then question headings in italic, each followed by its answer paragraph. A large woodcut initial P opens the first answer. No marginal notes. Small page number "I" at the head. A small mark at the foot centre.

main_text.head: SYNTAGMA PHILIPPORA-MEUM AR-tium Libera-lium.
main_text.p: Ars est comprehensio præcepto-rum, in rebus æternis propriorum, & ordine dispositorum, ad utilem vitæ finem spe-ctantium.
In Exotericas & Acroamaticas. In schlechte unnd hohe künste.
Tres: Physica, Mathematica, Ethica. Physica circa rerum qualitatem versatur: Mathematica circa re-rum quantitatem: Ethica circa mores.

page.notes: Decorative ornament above the title and the woodcut initial P (ornamental letter, no text). Title line 'ARtium' is printed with a capital A and lower-case rest, copied as printed. Long s is rendered as plain s throughout. The black letter words 'In schlechte unnd hohe künste' are set in Fraktur within the roman text. The heading 'Acroamaticæ' has an unusual capital A form, read as A. The small mark at the foot centre is uncertain and is recorded as signature 'a[?]'. Faint show-through at the top right and right margin is not transcribed.
